race.title: Racing Again November 19th Beginners Chase
race.verdict: WHISPERING WILLOW underperformed over hurdles last time but had previously shaped well over fences and is worth chancing back in this sphere with first-time cheekpieces applied. In-form hurdler Might Be The One is feared most if transferring that ability to fences with Kimy also respected after a promising chase debut at Tramore. WHISPERING WILLOW (IRE) MIGHT BE THE ONE (IRE) KIMY (FR)
